mentions.name: Afrika Labs
mentions.description: An open speech-to-text model for Kikuyu (~8M speakers), built by fine-tuning Whisper on a cleaned 144-hour Kikuyu corpus. The first model achieves 32.9% WER / 10.5% CER, close to the published SOTA of 26% from a model 6x larger. Part of a broader effort to bring working ASR to Africa's 2,000+ languages, most of which lack it; the author also found systematic encoding corruption (mangled diacritics) in the source corpus's unscripted transcripts.
mentions.problem: Almost none of Africa's 2,000+ languages have working ASR; Kikuyu lacked an open speech-to-text model.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Afrika Labs (https://afrikalabs.org). An open speech-to-text for Kikuyu (Kĩkũyũ, ~8M speakers).

Almost none of Africa's 2,000+ languages have working ASR. Fine-tuned Whisper on a cleaned 144h Kikuyu corpus.
